entries.zh: 把东西扔到某处；丢开、抛下
entries.en: to throw something somewhere; to fling it down, to cast it away
entries.notes: L 中段「ellven」不可解，H 末字 [疑:棄/處]，四栏仍合于「丢掉」义。

entries.zh: 把东西往下扔，掷落下来
entries.en: to throw something downwards, to fling it down
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:擦/擲]，与 L「arrojar」相协者为「擲」。

entries.en: to throw (it) somewhere, to cast (it) into a place

entries.zh: 投入水中，把（人、物）扔下水
entries.en: to throw (someone or something) into the water
to throw (someone or something) into the well

entries.zh: 把木料（柴）抛出去，甩出去
entries.en: to fling or hurl wood away from oneself
entries.notes: L「leños（木料）」与次条「lexos（远）」形近，此处按木料解，故降置信。

entries.en: to fling far away from oneself; to cast off, to discard
to throw or dash something to the ground
entries.notes: L「por tiendo」当为「por tierra（向地上）」之讹；H 首字 [疑]，取「摔掷」义。

entries.en: to put or lay something down; to cast it down
entries.notes: H 次字 [疑:捺/换]，M 作「ha」指向「下」，即「放下」。

entries.en: to throw off, to cast away from oneself
entries.notes: H 末字 [疑:摈/損]，与 M「cap」、R「chày」不合，义从「弃掷」。

entries.en: to throw away, to discard
to cast away, to forsake, to reject
to fling away, to throw off
to throw open, to scatter by flinging
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:發/撥]，两读皆通「撒开」；L「abriendo」指张开、摊开。

entries.en: to dash against, to collide; to hurl oneself at
entries.notes: H 字 [疑:撞/常]，取「撞」；L 单作 arrojar 而 H 作「撞」，义为投撞。

entries.en: to dash against; to charge into
to dash or throw it upwards
entries.notes: M 尾「aniba」当为西语 arriba 之衍，可证「向上」义。

entries.en: to dash it downwards
entries.notes: M 尾「abayo」当为西语 abajo 之衍，可证「向下」义。

entries.zh: 掷籤（投掷占卜用的竹签）
entries.en: to throw divination lots (bamboo sticks, Sp. cañas)
entries.notes: L「mandarinong canas ¥ guoacufen」残乱，唯「canas」与 H「載[疑:籤]」及 M、R 之 chiām/chièn 相呼应，西语义终未能定。

entries.en: to scatter, to broadcast
to scatter about, to fling apart
entries.notes: R 栏附注「(Bong hiin)」来源未详，姑存。

entries.zh: 泼洒，摊开（把东西倒出来、铺开）
entries.en: to pour out, to spill; to spread open
to sow, to scatter seed

entries.zh: 撂倒、扔倒（把东西摔倒在地）
entries.en: to throw (something) down, to knock it over
entries.notes: L「baciendo, obot viendo」残乱不可解，仅 H「倒」与 M「to」可定「撂倒」义。

entries.en: to shove or knock (something) over
entries.notes: L「ut baciando」不可解，H「到[疑:到/倒]＋挨」与 M「to ta」不足以定夺，暂按「推倒」解。

entries.en: to throw out the rubbish; to sweep away
entries.notes: L 明作「la basura（垃圾）」，H 作「掃除」，合为「清扫倒掉」。
